name: Pitztaler Nachtigall
beschreibung: The Hotel Pitztaler Nachtigall is located in the Pitztal, an alpine side valley of the Ötztal in Nordtirol. The surroundings are characterized by mountainous landscape and managed alpine pastures. Guests can use hiking trails and ski slopes here, which are accessible in the nearby area. The hotel offers typical Tiroler hospitality with regional cuisine and cozy common rooms.
